name: How can I prepare my home for a multi-room interior renovation?

mainEntity.name: How can I prepare my home for a multi-room interior renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Preparing your home involves several steps to protect your belongings and facilitate the renovation. Start by decluttering and packing away personal items from the rooms being renovated. Remove or cover furniture that cannot be moved. Consider setting up a temporary kitchen or bathroom if those areas will be unusable. Discuss with your contractor where materials will be stored and how access will be managed. Good preparation helps prevent damage, speeds up the process, and ensures a smoother renovation experience.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prepare by decluttering, packing personal items, removing or covering furniture, and planning for temporary living arrangements if needed. Discuss material storage and access with your contractor.
